About Wati
Started as a WhatsApp team inbox in 2020, Wati has evolved into an AI-powered customer engagement platform that goes beyond a single channel. Designed for businesses that sell, support, and grow through conversations, Wati observes customer intent in real time, decides the next best revenue action, and executes it across marketing, sales, and support — on WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, SMS, and more.

Trusted by over 16,000 customers across 190+ countries, Wati simplifies complex operations and business conversations with a unified inbox, no-code automation, and Wati AI powered by AI Copilot, Astra AI Agent and flexibility to add your own LLMs/AI.

Proudly backed by Tiger Global, Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and Shopify, and recognised as a Premium Partner of Meta and Google.

Wati, the AI-Powered Customer Engagement Platform for Revenue Growth.

About the role-

A Level 2 Product Support Engineer - Level 2 is crucial in providing advanced technical assistance to customers or internal teams beyond what Level 1 support can handle. They are responsible for troubleshooting complex technical issues, resolving problems, and ensuring high customer satisfaction.

This role follows rotational shifts across APAC (6 AM–3 PM IST), General (9 AM–6 PM / 10 AM–7 PM IST), and EMEA (1 PM–9 PM / 2 PM–10 PM IST). There are no night shifts, but flexibility is required during incident escalations. The role also include weekend shifts while maintaining a 5-day work week.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Technical Expertise: Serve as the second-level technical support expert for our SaaS product, demonstrating an in-depth understanding of our software's functionalities, configurations, and integrations.
  • Advanced Troubleshooting: Investigate and resolve complex technical issues escalated from Level 1 support, including but not limited to software bugs, integration problems, and data-related issues.
  • Customer Interaction: Communicate with customers or end-users in a professional, empathetic, and customer-centric manner, ensuring their technical issues are addressed promptly and effectively.
  • Documentation: Accurately document all customer interactions, resolutions, and technical solutions in the support ticketing system, maintaining comprehensive and organised records.
  • Escalation Management: Collaborate closely with Level 1 support agents, product development teams, and other internal departments to escalate and prioritise critical issues and ensure timely resolutions.
  • Training and Mentorship: Assist in training and mentoring Level 1 support agents, sharing your technical knowledge and best practices to improve their skills and knowledge.
  • Product Knowledge Sharing: Stay updated with the latest features, updates, and enhancements of our SaaS product, and share this knowledge with the support team and customers.
  • Quality Assurance: Ensure that all support interactions meet or exceed established quality and service standards, continuously improving the support process.
  • Feedback Loop: Provide valuable feedback to the product development team based on recurring technical issues, customer feedback, and suggestions for product improvement.
","requirements":"
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • 4+ years experience in a technical support role, with a strong focus on troubleshooting complex technical issues related to SaaS products.
  • Proficiency in using and troubleshooting SaaS applications.
  • Hands-on experience with APIs, webhooks, scripting, and working knowledge of MongoDB or similar databases.
  • Knowledge of data handling, migration, and security within SaaS environments.
  • Experience with remote support tools and troubleshooting methods.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical users.
  • Experience with modern customer support platforms (e.g., Intercom, Zendesk, Freshdesk).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to think critically and logically.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and guide junior support agents.
  • Relevant technical certifications (e.g., ITIL, SaaS-specific certifications) would be an added advantage
","benefits":""}

About the Role

We are looking for a Support Intern to join our Customer Support team and gain hands-on experience in supporting a fast-growing SaaS product. This role is ideal for someone who wants to build a career in customer support, customer success, or SaaS operations.

As a Support Intern, you will work closely with experienced support specialists to assist customers via tickets and live chat, learn product workflows, and understand how world-class SaaS support teams operate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Respond to customer queries via tickets and live chat under guidance
  • Understand customer issues and provide accurate, timely resolutions
  • Escalate bugs and complex issues to internal teams with proper documentation
  • Learn and follow SLAs, response time, and quality standards
  • Update internal knowledge base and FAQs
  • Assist in testing product features and reproducing customer-reported issues
  • Analyze recurring issues and suggest improvements to support processes
  • Maintain clear and professional communication with customers

What You Will Learn

  • How SaaS customer support operates end-to-end
  • Ticketing systems, live chat tools, and CRM workflows
  • Basics of product troubleshooting and root cause analysis
  • Customer communication best practices
  • Working with Engineering, Product, and QA teams
  • Support metrics such as FRT, ART, CSAT, and ticket categorization

","requirements":"

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Willingness to learn and a customer-first mindset
  • Basic understanding of web applications (browsers, internet, SaaS tools)
  • Good problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in any discipline

Good to Have (not mandatory)

  • Basic knowledge of SaaS or B2B products
  • Familiarity with support tools like Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, etc.
  • Basic technical knowledge (APIs, logs, SQL, or HTML)
  • Prior internship or customer-facing experience

Who Should Apply

  • Students or fresh graduates interested in SaaS, Technical  Support, Customer Support, or Customer Success
  • Individuals looking to start a career in tech without heavy coding requirements
  • Fast learners with strong communication skills
","benefits":"

Internship Benefits

  • Hands-on experience in a real-world SaaS support environment
  • Mentorship from experienced support leaders
  • Certificate of completion and a Recommendation/Experience letter
  • Opportunity for full-time role conversion based on performance and requirements
  • Exposure to global customers and real production systems
"}

{"id":5268815,"shortcode":"04F012771D","title":"Lead Product Designer","remote":true,"location":{"city":"","country":"India","countryCode":"IN","region":null},"locations":[{"city":"","country":"India","countryCode":"IN","hidden":false,"region":null}],"state":"published","isInternal":false,"code":"","published":"2026-07-16T00:00:00.000Z","type":"full","language":"en","department":["Product"],"accountUid":"da70e071-85cc-431f-b985-66f433ef6d33","approvalStatus":"approved","workplace":"remote","description":"

Wati is the world's leading WhatsApp-first conversational growth platform, empowering businesses to build deeper customer relationships and accelerate revenue growth.

Trusted and loved by over 20,000+ customers across 100+ countries, Wati has established itself as the premier choice for businesses leveraging WhatsApp and other messaging channels to connect with customers on their platform of choice.

In a world where real-time interactions drive growth, Wati's story is all about business growth through conversations. At Wati, we believe that every conversation matters, whether it's engaging a first-time prospect, nurturing a qualified lead, or deepening relationships with loyal clients. We transform these conversations into opportunities for building relationships, and strong relationships lead to increased revenue.

Our Platform
The AI-native platform simplifies complex business operations by bringing all customer interactions under one intelligent roof. Designed for scalability and ease of use, our solution delivers a measurable ROI while adapting to businesses of all sizes, from emerging startups to established enterprises.

Our Backing & Partnerships
Wati is proudly backed by world-class investors including Tiger Global, Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and Shopify. As a Premium-tier Partner of Meta, Google, and WhatsApp, we maintain the highest standards of integration and platform excellence.

We’re looking for a Lead Product Designer who brings clarity, craft, and curiosity to how we design and build our SaaS platform. You’ll design experiences that help businesses connect better with their customers and lead the effort to make every part of our product simple, useful, and enjoyable.

You’ll work closely with product managers, engineers, and other designers to shape what we build next. You’ll own design for key areas of the product, guide other designers, and help raise the quality and consistency of our design system and mobile experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead end-to-end design for core product areas, from discovery to implementation.
  • Translate customer needs into clear, intuitive experiences informed by competitor insights, research data, and UX best practices.
  • Build a deep understanding of competitor features and customer needs at a persona level.
  • Use modern tools and AI-assisted workflows to iterate faster, prototype new ideas, and validate through user testing.
  • Lead user research to identify key touchpoints and define measurable criteria for UX effectiveness and efficiency by guiding other designers in conducting interviews, analyzing insights, and applying data-driven design principles.
  • Own and evolve our design system to improve consistency, scalability, and ease of use across the product.
  • Partner with engineering to ensure our design system is implemented accurately and continuously improved.
  • Reimagine and enhance mobile app experience, ensuring parity and coherence with the web app.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to refine ideas based on feedback and improve designs as they’re built.
  • Mentor designers, review their work, and support their growth.Mentor designers by reviewing their work and offering clear, actionable feedback that fosters their growth.
  • Contribute to product and business strategy by connecting design decisions to outcomes.
  • Build and present completing design demos to leadership to secure stakeholder alignment and buy-in.

","requirements":"
  • 10+ years of experience in Product Design, with at least 3 years in a lead role.
  • A portfolio that shows strength in UX, interaction, and visual design.
  • Expertise in Figma and proficiency with prototyping, design systems, and collaboration tools.
  • Experience designing for complex systems or SaaS products.
  • Proven experience improving or maintaining a design system.
  • Experience designing for mobile apps and understanding platform-specific design patterns.
  • Strong understanding of user research methods and how to turn insights into actionable ideas.
  • Hands-on with tools that enable faster iteration, prototyping, and testing.
  • Curiosity around AI adoption in design and the ability to experiment with new tools or workflows.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to work well with cross-functional teams.
  • Comfort discussing technical constraints with developers and finding practical solutions.
  • A strategic mindset that connects design to business goals.
  • Experience with AI-driven or conversational products.
","benefits":"

You’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Design a product used by thousands of businesses worldwide
  • Work with a thoughtful, collaborative, and motivated team.
  • Take real ownership of your work and space to experiment and innovate.
  • Enjoy flexible hours and a culture that values craft, curiosity, and learning.
"}

{"id":5897009,"shortcode":"D6A461CC4E","title":"Partner Development","remote":false,"location":{"city":"chennai","country":"India","countryCode":"IN","region":"Tamil Nadu"},"locations":[{"city":"chennai","country":"India","countryCode":"IN","hidden":false,"region":"Tamil Nadu"},{"city":"Bengaluru","country":"India","countryCode":"IN","hidden":false,"region":"Karnataka"}],"state":"published","isInternal":false,"code":"","published":"2026-06-17T00:00:00.000Z","language":"en","department":[],"accountUid":"da70e071-85cc-431f-b985-66f433ef6d33","approvalStatus":"approved","workplace":"hybrid","description":"

About Wati 

Started as a WhatsApp team inbox in 2020, Wati has evolved into a full revenue orchestration system that goes beyond a single platform. We empower businesses that sell, support, and grow through conversations by observing customer intent in real-time, deciding the next best revenue action, and executing it seamlessly across marketing, sales, and support—all within WhatsApp and connected messaging channels.

Our Platform & AI Capabilities 

Wati is designed for scalability and intelligence. Our AI-native platform simplifies complex customer communication operations through a unified inbox, a robust multi-channel messaging infrastructure, and no-code automation. At the heart of our solution is Astra, our intelligent AI layer, which helps you create AI Agents for all customer interactions and all your messaging platforms. By integrating AI agents into the ecosystem, we enable businesses of all sizes to deliver measurable ROI and build deeper customer relationships.

Our Backing & Partnerships 

Trusted by over 16,000 customers across 190+ countries, Wati is proudly backed by world-class investors including Tiger Global, Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and Shopify. As a Premium-tier Partner of Meta and Google, we maintain the highest standards of platform excellence and integration.

Role Overview

As a Partner Development resource, you’ll play a key role in driving the growth and success of our partner ecosystem. You will be responsible for identifying, engaging, onboarding and nurturing strategic partnerships that align with our company goals. Working closely with partner managers, marketing, and product teams, you'll help onboard new partners, support co-marketing efforts, and ensure partner satisfaction. Your ability to build strong relationships, communicate value, and execute joint go-to-market plans will be essential to expanding our market reach and accelerating revenue growth through partners. This will be a global role covering India, UK, EU, MEA and SEA markets.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

  • Identify and recruit new partners (via inbound & outbound channels) who meet the defined IPP and align with company goals and market strategy.
  • Onboard (qualification, NDA and agreements) and train new partners to ensure successful GTM &  integration into our ecosystem.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with partners to drive collaboration and performance.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (partner managers, marketing, product) to develop and execute partner strategies.
  • Assist in developing co-marketing and joint sales initiatives to increase brand visibility and revenue.
  • Act as a point of contact for partner inquiries, resolving issues and escalating as needed.
  • Maintain a thorough understanding of industry trends and competitor activities in the partner space.

","requirements":"
  • Experience: 1-4 years in partner development, business development, inside sales in SaaS with a focus on revenue growth.
  • Proven success in building and managing partner relationships.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Experience with CRM, MR, and PRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, Apollo, PartnerStack, etc.).
  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Self-starter with excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • MBA/PGDM degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field (preferred).
","benefits":""}

{"id":5867087,"shortcode":"C26EFAD507","title":"Performance Marketing Manager","remote":false,"location":{"city":"Bengaluru","country":"India","countryCode":"IN","region":"Karnataka"},"locations":[{"city":"Bengaluru","country":"India","countryCode":"IN","hidden":false,"region":"Karnataka"},{"city":"Chennai","country":"India","countryCode":"IN","hidden":false,"region":"Tamil Nadu"},{"city":"Hong Kong","country":"Hong Kong","countryCode":"HK","hidden":false,"region":"Hong Kong"},{"city":"Shenzhen","country":"China","countryCode":"CN","hidden":false,"region":"Guangdong Province"}],"state":"published","isInternal":false,"code":"","published":"2026-06-06T00:00:00.000Z","language":"en","department":["Marketing"],"accountUid":"da70e071-85cc-431f-b985-66f433ef6d33","approvalStatus":"approved","workplace":"hybrid","description":"

About Wati

Started as a WhatsApp team inbox in 2020, Wati has evolved into an AI-powered customer engagement platform that goes beyond a single channel. Designed for businesses that sell, support, and grow through conversations, Wati observes customer intent in real time, decides the next best revenue action, and executes it across marketing, sales, and support — on WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, SMS, and more.

Trusted by over 16,000 customers across 190+ countries, Wati simplifies complex operations and business conversations with a unified inbox, no-code automation, and our intelligent AI layer, Astra.

Proudly backed by Tiger Global, Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and Shopify, and recognised as a Premium Partner of Meta and Google.

About the role

As a Performance Marketing Lead at Wati, you'll own the strategy, execution, and optimisation of paid acquisition across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn, and emerging channels globally.

You'll own performance end-to-end — from creative strategy, campaign setup and experimentation to landing page optimisation, budget allocation, and deciding what to scale, pause, or change. Your success won't be measured by lead volume alone, but by your ability to drive qualified pipeline, customers, and revenue while managing CAC efficiently.

This role is for someone who combines strong performance instincts, creative thinking, analytical rigour, and ownership — someone who stays close to the platforms, understands what drives B2B SaaS growth, and can quickly turn learnings into clear next actions.

What you'll do

  • Plan, launch, and optimise paid campaigns across Google Ads (Search, PMax, Display, Demand Gen), Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), LinkedIn Ads, and other relevant channels across global markets
  • Own paid acquisition end-to-end — from creative concepts and audience targeting to bid strategy, landing page experience, budget allocation, experimentation, and performance optimisation
  • Drive performance beyond lead generation, connecting paid acquisition to qualified pipeline, customer acquisition, revenue, and CAC
  • Own budget allocation and continuously make data-driven decisions on what to scale, pause, optimise, or change across campaigns, channels, audiences, and markets
  • Develop and run structured experiments across creative, messaging, audiences, offers, landing pages, and campaign strategy to uncover scalable growth opportunities
  • Monitor performance and proactively identify opportunities to improve CPL, CAC, conversion rates, pipeline efficiency, and overall marketing ROI
  • Work closely with design and content teams to develop, brief, test, and iterate on ad creatives — bringing both strong creative judgment and performance data into the process
  • Partner with Growth, Product, and relevant teams to continuously improve landing pages and the end-to-end conversion funnel
  • Build and maintain performance dashboards and reporting that connect campaign performance with downstream business outcomes and surface clear, actionable insights
  • Stay on top of platform updates, algorithm changes, beta features, and industry trends — and actively test new opportunities where they can improve performance
  • Conduct competitor analysis and ad benchmarking to identify whitespace and inform campaign and creative strategy
  • Support budget planning, forecasting, pacing, and spend management across platforms and markets
","requirements":"
    • 5–7 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, ideally with a strong track record in B2B SaaS, technology, or a similar recurring-revenue business
    • Proven experience running and scaling paid acquisition across international markets
    • Deep hands-on expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads — you understand campaign architecture, bidding strategies, audience mechanics, creative performance, and how to diagnose and improve results
    • Strong understanding of the B2B acquisition funnel, with experience optimising beyond leads toward qualified pipeline, customers, revenue, and CAC
    • Proven experience owning meaningful paid media budgets and making independent decisions on budget allocation, scaling, and optimisation
    • Strong creative thinking — able to develop hypotheses, identify creative opportunities, write sharp briefs, and understand why certain messages and creatives convert
    • Experience with landing page optimisation, conversion rate optimisation, and structured A/B testing
    • Strong analytical skills — comfortable using GA4, HubSpot, Supermetrics, or similar tools to understand performance across the funnel
    • Strong understanding of conversion tracking, UTM structures, attribution models, and pixel/tag implementation
    • Strong reporting and communication skills — able to turn complex performance data into clear insights, decisions, and next actions
    • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, global environment with a high degree of ownership and autonomy
  • Nice to have
    • Hands-on experience with programmatic advertising
    • Experience with LinkedIn Ads and other paid channels such as TikTok
    • Experience with creator/influencer marketing campaigns and tracking
    • Familiarity with WhatsApp Business API or messaging-first GTM strategies
    • Hands-on experience with Looker Studio, Supermetrics, or similar reporting tools
    • Knowledge of SEO and organic growth as a complement to paid strategy
    • Experience running campaigns in Africa, LATAM, MENA, or SEA markets
  • Tools you'll use
    • Ad platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager
    • Analytics & CRM: Google Analytics 4 (GA4), HubSpot CRM
    • Reporting: Looker Studio, Supermetrics, Google Sheets
    • Creative: Canva, Figma
    • Tracking: Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, UTM frameworks

","benefits":"

Why Wati

  • Ownership from day one — you'll run real campaigns with real budgets across global markets
  • Fast-moving team that values data, creativity, and speed in equal measure
  • Work on a product that's genuinely transforming how businesses communicate
  • Competitive compensation, remote-first culture, and room to grow fast
  • Direct exposure to senior leadership and a seat at the strategy table
"}

Scope of work
Sales enablement

About the Role

We are looking for a data-driven Performance Marketing Growth Lead to architect our global paid acquisition engine as we scale to our next growth milestone.

This role goes beyond campaign management. You will own the full-funnel paid growth strategy, leveraging automation, AI-driven optimization, and advanced attribution to drive qualified pipeline and efficient CAC across global markets.

You will manage significant budgets across Search, Paid Social, and emerging AI-powered ad ecosystems, working closely with Sales, Regional Marketing, Brand, and RevOps to ensure paid media directly contributes to revenue growth.

What You Will Own (The Outcomes)

1. Revenue-Backed Paid Strategy

  • Deploy significant capital across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and emerging AI ecosystems.
  • Every campaign must have a clear revenue logic, target pipeline metric, and payback period. If the math doesn't work, you don't launch it.
  • Evolve the channel mix aggressively based on marginal CAC and incremental lift, breaking our reliance on single channels.

2. End-to-End Funnel Ownership

  • Own the system, not just the entry point: Channel → Activation → Pipeline → Revenue.
  • Design campaigns across the entire buyer journey. Partner directly with Sales and RevOps to ensure the leads you generate actually convert to ARR.
  • Target higher-value, AI-ready segments (Mid-Market/Enterprise) that drive higher ACV and expansion.

3. AI-Native Experimentation Engine

  • We sell AI. We must operate with AI. You will build a high-velocity experimentation engine using AI-assisted creative iteration (copy, hooks, localization).
  • Move fast with accountability: Launch quickly, iterate weekly, kill quickly if it doesn't work, and scale aggressively if it does.

4. Data Clarity & Ruthless Attribution

  • Partner with Analytics to build a robust attribution framework (GA4, HubSpot, Ad Platforms).
  • Provide simple, sharp visibility on: Channel → Revenue conversion, CAC by region/segment, Cohort performance, and Payback periods.
  • Do not hide behind dashboards. Know exactly what drives revenue and double down on it.

5. High-Ownership Team Leadership

  • Hire, mentor, and scale a small, high-accountability team of performance specialists.
  • Set the bar: We are building category shapers, not task executors. If an initiative cannot connect clearly to pipeline or revenue, you kill it.

What \"Great\" Looks Like in This Role

  • You are a Funnel Mathematician: You understand CAC, LTV, payback periods, and incrementality better than anyone else in the room.
  • You are AI-Native: You use AI not just for copywriting, but for predictive audience modeling, smart bidding manipulation, and scaling campaign creation.
  • You operate without heavy supervision: You don't bring vague questions; you bring 2-3 structured options, revenue impact estimates, and a recommendation.

","requirements":"
  • Proven Revenue Builder: Demonstrated track record of managing large B2B SaaS paid budgets where success was measured by closed-won ARR, not MQLs or traffic.
  • Technical Mastery: Deep expertise in Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta, and automation-driven campaign management (smart bidding, conversion APIs).
  • Data Fluency: Exceptional analytical capability across GA4, HubSpot, and direct ad platforms. You can build and defend a cohort analysis.
  • Speed & Execution: Experience building structured, high-velocity experimentation and testing programs.
  • Leadership: Proven ability to lead a high-performance team with weekly review loops and strict decision deadlines.

What Will Make You Fail Here

  • Focusing on vanity metrics (Traffic, Clicks, CPL) disconnected from ARR targets.
  • Endless planning without rapid execution.
  • Heavy manual processes that should be automated with AI.

","benefits":""}
